title: ClawLoop：基于Harness原生训练循环的自我改进智能体
summary: ClawLoop提出一种无需外部教师模型的自我改进框架，通过任务合成、训练、诊断反馈三阶段循环，让基于harness的LLM智能体持续提升能力，并在多个基准上验证了迭代任务可迁移至更小模型。
summary_en: ClawLoop proposes a self-improving framework without external teacher models, cycling through task synthesis, training, and diagnosis-feedback to continuously enhance harness-based LLM agents, with iterative tasks transferring to smaller models across benchmarks.
